LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdGalaxyMapDesc: Shows nearby stars, what sensors know about them, and the whole galaxy. Warp jumps start here.
LanguageData.Rimverse_SelectStar: Click a star to see its details.
LanguageData.Rimverse_StarNeedsScan: Only the star's color is visible. Bring sensors closer to learn more.
LanguageData.Rimverse_WarpSummary: Warp: up to {0} light years, up to {1} t, {2} warp matter
LanguageData.Rimverse_NoWarpDriveShort: This ship has no working warp drive.
LanguageData.Rimverse_WarpCooldownLeft: The warp drive recharges in {0} h.
LanguageData.Rimverse_WarpEstimate: Jump of {0} light years: {1} warp matter, {2} day.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgWarpStarted: {0} has entered warp toward {1} ({2} light years).
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterWarpArrived: {0} has left warp in the {1} system, near {2}, the body farthest from the star.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemNoWarpDrive: The ship has no working warp drive.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemWarpRange: Distance is {0} light years, but the drive only reaches {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemWarpMass: The ship weighs {0} t, but the warp drives can only move {1} t.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemWarpCooldown: The warp drive is still recharging for {0} h.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemOtherGalaxy: That star is in another galaxy.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ProblemTravelRule: In this galaxy the travel rule is {0}; ordinary warp does not work here.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GalaxyYouAreHere: Your ship is in this galaxy (green square). The white square is your home system.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_Sensor_Desc: Lower is better. Up to 10,000: rough at 5 light years. Up to 1,000: ranged at 20 light years. Up to 100: exact at 50 light years.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_WarpRange_Desc: Maximum jump distance. The ship uses the longest range among its warp drives.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_WarpMaxMass_Desc: How much mass this drive can carry in a jump. Several drives add up.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Stat_WarpCapacity_Desc: How much warp matter this module holds.
LanguageData.Rimverse_TravelRuleDesc_Warp: Warp drives jump freely between stars within range.
LanguageData.Rimverse_TravelRuleDesc_WarpBarRoutes: Ordinary warp, and the central bar holds fast routes between its ends.
LanguageData.Rimverse_TravelRuleDesc_AncientGates: Ordinary warp fails here. Only gates left by an ancient civilization link the stars.
LanguageData.Rimverse_TravelRuleDesc_Hyperlanes: Jumps only work along fixed lanes between neighboring stars.
LanguageData.Rimverse_TravelRuleDesc_Sublight: There is no warp here. Travel between stars is slow and done in cryosleep.
LanguageData.Rimverse_TravelRuleDesc_Wormholes: Unstable wormholes open and close, linking distant points.
